title: A line report
description:
Read text line by line and report on each line, then on the whole input. For

```
Hello world
  assembly   is fun
x
```

print

```
1: 11 chars, 2 words, reversed: dlrow olleH
2: 19 chars, 3 words, reversed: nuf si   ylbmessa  
3: 1 chars, 1 words, reversed: x
lines: 3
longest: "  assembly   is fun"
vowels: 7
```

- A **word** is a run of characters that are not spaces (only the space character counts here).
- `reversed:` is the whole line backwards, spaces included (the second line's reversed text ends with the two spaces that started it).
- `longest:` is the longest line in quotes (the first one if tied); with no lines at all print `lines: 0` and nothing else.
- `vowels:` counts a, e, i, o, u in either case, in all the lines.
- Lines are at most 200 characters.

starter.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .bss
line:   resb    256

        section .text
_start:
.next:
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        mov     esi, 256
        call    read_line
        cmp     rax, -1
        je      .exit
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        call    print_str
        call    print_newline
        jmp     .next
.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

solution.main.asm:
global  _start
        section .bss
line:     resb  256
reversed: resb  256
longest:  resb  256

        section .data
s_colon:  db    ": ", 0
s_chars:  db    " chars, ", 0
s_words:  db    " words, reversed: ", 0
s_lines:  db    "lines: ", 0
s_long:   db    "longest: ", 34, 0
s_quote:  db    34, 10, 0
s_vowels: db    "vowels: ", 0

        section .text
; rdi = string -> rax = its length
str_length:
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  cmp     byte [rdi + rax], 0
        je      .done
        inc     rax
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

; rdi = string -> rax = the words in it (runs of non-spaces)
count_words:
        xor     eax, eax
        xor     ecx, ecx                ; 1 while inside a word
.loop:  movzx   edx, byte [rdi]
        test    dl, dl
        jz      .done
        cmp     dl, ' '
        jne     .letter
        xor     ecx, ecx
        jmp     .next
.letter:
        test    ecx, ecx
        jnz     .next
        mov     ecx, 1
        inc     rax
.next:  inc     rdi
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

; rdi = destination, rsi = string, rdx = its length: writes the string backwards with a 0
reverse_copy:
        lea     rcx, [rsi + rdx]        ; one past the last character
.loop:  cmp     rcx, rsi
        jbe     .done
        dec     rcx
        movzx   eax, byte [rcx]
        mov     [rdi], al
        inc     rdi
        jmp     .loop
.done:  mov     byte [rdi], 0
        ret

; rdi = string -> rax = its vowels
count_vowels:
        xor     eax, eax
.loop:  movzx   ecx, byte [rdi]
        test    cl, cl
        jz      .done
        or      cl, 0x20                ; lower case (harmless for other characters here)
        cmp     cl, 'a'
        je      .yes
        cmp     cl, 'e'
        je      .yes
        cmp     cl, 'i'
        je      .yes
        cmp     cl, 'o'
        je      .yes
        cmp     cl, 'u'
        jne     .next
.yes:   inc     rax
.next:  inc     rdi
        jmp     .loop
.done:  ret

_start:
        xor     r12d, r12d              ; lines
        mov     r13, -1                 ; the longest length so far
        xor     r14d, r14d              ; vowels
.next:
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        mov     esi, 256
        call    read_line
        cmp     rax, -1
        je      .summary
        mov     rbx, rax                ; this line's length
        inc     r12

        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        call    count_vowels
        add     r14, rax

        cmp     rbx, r13
        jle     .not_longest
        mov     r13, rbx
        lea     rsi, [rel line]
        lea     rdi, [rel longest]
        lea     rcx, [rbx + 1]          ; the characters and the 0
        rep movsb
.not_longest:
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel s_colon]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, rbx
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel s_chars]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel line]
        call    count_words
        mov     rdi, rax
        call    print_int
        lea     rdi, [rel s_words]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel reversed]
        lea     rsi, [rel line]
        mov     rdx, rbx
        call    reverse_copy
        lea     rdi, [rel reversed]
        call    print_str
        call    print_newline
        jmp     .next

.summary:
        lea     rdi, [rel s_lines]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r12
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
        test    r12, r12
        jz      .exit
        lea     rdi, [rel s_long]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel longest]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel s_quote]
        call    print_str
        lea     rdi, [rel s_vowels]
        call    print_str
        mov     rdi, r14
        call    print_int
        call    print_newline
.exit:
        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

requirements: Write the string work as functions that take the address in `rdi`: one for the length, one for counting words, one that reverses a copy into a second buffer.
Keep a copy of the longest line in its own buffer, copied with `rep movsb`.
Save any of rbx, rbp and r12 to r15 that a function uses, with push and pop.
